runtime.compose_entrypoint: /bin/sh -c 'sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=1 >/dev/null 2>&1; tailscaled --state=/var/lib/tailscale/tailscaled.state & i=0; while [ $i -lt 60 ]; do lan=$(ip -4 addr show dev eth0 2>/dev/null | sed -n "s/.*inet \([0-9.]*\)\/.*/\1/p" | head -n 1); [ -n "$lan" ] && break; i=$((i+1)); sleep 1; done; sleep 10; exec tailscale web --listen "${lan:-0.0.0.0}:5252"'
